title: It's a pretty rosary...
text: It's a pretty rosary.... The beads are shiny red with a hint of purple when you move the rosary. I like that it came with a St. Gertrude prayer card as well as the Chaplet prayer. The only problem is that the Chaplet prayer contains 7 mysteries, and the rosary only has 6 decades. If the Chaplet prayer would've matched the rosary, it would've been perfect!
